title: SI Core Engine
text: 从进气端口到排气端口的火花点火发动机，输入 9 路、输出 4 路；按 {Torque table load breakpoints, f_tq_nl_l_bpt} 指定断点 [0.2 0.275 0.35 0.425 0.5 0.575 0.65 0.725 0.8 0.875 0.95 1.025 1.1 1.175；{Air mass flow model} 指定空气质量流量模型 Dual-Independent Variable Cam、{Torque model} 指定转矩模型 Torque、{Number of cylinders, NCyl} 指定发动机气缸数、{Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps} 指定每冲程转数、{Total displaced volume, Vd} 指定体积、{Ideal gas constant air, Rair} 指定常量、{Air standard pressure, Pstd} 指定压力、{Air standard temperature, Tstd} 指定温度、{Speed-density volumetric efficiency, f_nv} 查找表 array、{Speed-density intake manifold pressure breakpoints, f_nv_prs_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed-density engine speed breakpoints, f_nv_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Cylinder volume at intake valve close table, f_vivc} 指定二维查找表 array、{Cylinder volume intake cam phase breakpoints, f_vivc_icp_bpt} 指定断点、{Cylinder trapped mass correction factor, f_tm_corr} 查找表 array、{Normalized density breakpoints, f_tm_corr_nd_bpt} 指定断点、{Engine speed breakpoints, f_tm_corr_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Intake mass flow, f_mdot_intk} 查找表 array、{Exhaust cam phase breakpoints, f_mdot_air_ecp_bpt} 指定断点、{Trapped mass flow breakpoints, f_mdot_trpd_bpt} 指定断点、{Air mass flow correction factor, f_mdot_air_corr} 查找表 array、{Engine load breakpoints for air mass flow correction, f_mdot_air_corr_ld_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Engine speed breakpoints for air mass flow correction, f_mdot_air_n_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Torque table, f_tq_nl} 查找表、{Torque table speed breakpoints, f_tq_nl_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Crank angle pressure and torque} 启用曲轴角信号、{Cylinder pressure, f_crk_prs} 指定气缸压力表 L x M x、{Brake torque, f_crk_btq} 指定制动扭矩表 L x M x、{Speed breakpoints, f_crk_n_bpt} 指定速度断点、{Load breakpoints, f_crk_l_bpt} 指定负荷断点、{Crank angle breakpoints, f_crk_ang_bpt} 指定曲轴转角断点、{TDC compression angles by cylinder, f_crk_tdc_ang} 指定各气缸的 TDC 压缩角、{Inner torque table, f_tq_inr} 查找表 array、{Friction torque table, f_tq_fric} 查找表 array、{Engine temperature modifier on friction torque, f_fric_temp_mod} 查找表、{Engine temperature modifier breakpoints, f_fric_temp_bpt} 指定断点、{Pumping torque table, f_tq_pump} 查找表 array、{Optimal spark table, f_sa_opt} 查找表 array、{Inner torque load breakpoints, f_tq_inr_l_bpt} 指定断点、{Inner torque speed breakpoints, f_tq_inr_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Spark efficiency table, f_m_sa} 查找表 array、{Spark retard from optimal, f_del_sa_bpt} 指定断点、{Lambda efficiency, f_m_lam} 查找表 array、{Lambda breakpoints, f_m_lam_bpt} 指定断点、{Exhaust temperature table, f_t_exh} 查找表 array、{Load breakpoints, f_t_exh_l_bpt} 指定断点、{Speed breakpoints, f_t_exh_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Exhaust gas specific heat at constant pressure, cp_exh} 指定比热、{CO2 mass fraction table, f_CO2_frac} 指定二氧化碳、{CO mass fraction table, f_CO_frac} 指定一氧化碳、{HC mass fraction table, f_HC_frac} 指定碳氢化合物、{NOx mass fraction table, f_NOx_frac} 指定一氧化氮和二氧化氮、{PM mass fraction table, f_PM_frac} 指定颗粒物、{Engine speed breakpoints, f_exhfrac_n_bpt} 指定断点、{Engine torque breakpoints, f_exhfrac_trq_bpt} 指定断点、{Injector slope, Sinj} 指定斜率、{Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, afr_stoich} 指定空燃比、{Fuel lower heating value, fuel_lhv} 指定热值 46e6、{Fuel specific gravity, fuel_sg} 指定比重，按实例取值。
